title: fix(objectql)!: a non-system write may name, in a lookup or user field, only a record the caller can read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D5Rz8t1gS2DxNshrYSvUzdG)_

Fixes #29029

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — the write's reference check narrows: a non-system `lookup` or `user` value naming a record the caller cannot read is refused. The business-unit read widens: a delegated admin reads the business units inside the admin scope it holds, and no other.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches a reference to a record its writer cannot read, or a delegate's business-unit read (a grep of `skills/` for `reference_not_found` finds only the permission-set catalog refusal, unchanged); `content/docs` states the rule on four pages (below).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：非系统写在 `lookup` / `user` 字段里只能引用调用方自己读得到的记录，读不到的一律答 `reference_not_found`（与 `master_detail` 同一条规则），且先于记录校验规则；委派管理员的 adminScope 覆盖的业务单元子树，委派人可读这些单元，范围外一个不读。本 PR 接替 #30672（同一份代码，合并了最新 main，加上两处 CI 修复）。
- 为什么改：裁决 6663849489（A 重申 + 委派读）；检查清单该项按规则改写为第 7 版，#18682 的旧角色退役。
- 风险与回滚：BREAKING 收窄。依赖「引用读不到的记录」的非系统写会被拒，系统写（种子、安装、启动）豁免且顺序与结果不变；委派读只对 `sys_business_unit` 的读、只在调用方自己的权限集不给读时生效。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`（三条写路径的顺序）、`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts` 的 `delegatedUnitReadScope`、`security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` 第 2/3 步。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-unreadable-reference-target.test.ts`，预期 99/99 绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

> [!WARNING]
> **BREAKING** — accept-set narrowing at the write's reference check (`@objectstack/objectql`), served by every write door. After the upgrade, a write that is not a system write is refused `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` with the field's localized `reference_not_found` when a `lookup` or `user` value it supplies names a record the caller cannot read.

**Supersedes #30672.** Same change, continued by domain:server#4's card thread (session_016WV4d1ZVVUQY6crnfvCXhg) from #30672's released head `4ba91079fb` on a new branch with `main` merged; the seat retires #30672 with a pointer here.

## What changes

**The rule.** A write that is not a system write may name, in a `lookup`, `user` or `master_detail` field, only a record its caller's own read door returns. An unreadable reference target always answers `reference_not_found`, before the record's validation rules. A record the caller cannot read answers exactly as a record that exists nowhere, and so does one whose read by the caller fails. System writes (`isSystem`) stay exempt, keep the order they had and give the answer they gave; a flow run's elevated write keeps its existence check. A reference to an object the registry does not hold is not judged. `tree` keeps the existence check alone. A `lookup` or `user` value naming a user the caller cannot read answers `reference_not_found` and its ban is not asked; a user the caller can read is judged for its ban as before (#30205).

**The delegate read.** An admin scope over a business-unit subtree (ADR-0090 D12) grants read on the business units inside that subtree, and on no unit outside it. It applies to a read of `sys_business_unit` that the caller's own permission sets do not grant, on the caller's own behalf, bounded to the union of the subtrees the caller's held scopes cover. A caller with a `sys_business_unit` grant reads as that grant says, as before.

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-referential-integrity.ts` — `lookup` and `user` join `master_detail` on the caller's read door; `referencesCheckedBeforeRules`, the one predicate every write door and the validate preview read for the order.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, `engine-validate.ts` — insert, update by id, bulk update and the validate preview check references before the record's validation rules unless the write is a system write.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-references-and-master-detail.ts`, `engine-master-detail-related.ts` — the caller-readable reference helpers (`callerReadableReferenceExists`, and `callerReadableReferenceRow` for the user reference whose ban is also asked), and the #18682 docblock now states the rule.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts`, `security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` — `scopedBusinessUnitIds` and `delegatedUnitReadScope`; the middleware admits the read and narrows it to `id IN` the scoped units.
- `packages/verify/src/parent-write-reach.ts` — the parent-write-reach verifier's personas read every record of each object a probed detail's required reference names outside its master chain, so the create probe names records its writer can read.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` — `records-forms.predicate-relationship-traversal` takes revision 7, written to the rule.
- `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`, `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`, `content/docs/permissions/delegated-administration.mdx` — each states the rule where a sentence would otherwise have gone false.
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` — row 23 says where a system write's reference check runs, and the generated site register names `referencesCheckedBeforeRules`.
- `.changeset/29029-lookup-user-caller-read.md` — `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/plugin-security` and `@objectstack/verify`, patch.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-unreadable-reference-target.test.ts` (99): `lookup` and `user` × insert / batch insert / update by id / bulk update — an unreadable target is refused as one that exists nowhere; a refused read of the target object answers the same; a multi-valued field with one unreadable member; a system write; a stored value carried back; the read door before the elevated probe. On all four doors and for `lookup`, `user` and `master_detail`, an unreadable reference answers `reference_not_found` before the record's validation rules while a readable one reaches them; a reference to a record that exists nowhere answers the same before them; the validate preview agrees; controls — a system write and a flow run's system write keep the rules first, and a flow run's write keeps its reference check; a read of the target that fails is refused; a reference to an unregistered object is admitted.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` (33), three postures: a delegate reads exactly the units its scope covers (`find`, `findOne`, `count`); assigning a unit in scope is admitted; a unit outside the scope it cannot read is refused `reference_not_found`; controls — a writer with no scope, and an organization admin, unchanged.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/write-preview-field-gate-parity.test.ts`: the controls' callers read the related account; a new block drives the editor who cannot, and both doors answer the lookup's `reference_not_found`.
- Forced edits, rule-preserving: six plugin-security suites provision `sys_user` with a row per user they name (`__tests__/rig-users.testkit.ts`) and give organization callers the `org_user_ids` the runtime fills from `sys_member`; `agent-ceiling-grant-refusal` provisions the three users its grants name, as its sibling grant suites do; `predicate-related-read-tenant-scope` counts the rule's related reads alone, and the peer its rule reads carries an expired ban, so the rule, not the ban check, answers it; four plugin-audit suites leave the write's id-only reference-check read out of their read counters.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-banned-user-reference.test.ts` (11): the rig's caller reads a user's id, as a member does; the ban is read elevated; added: a user the caller cannot read is `reference_not_found`, and its ban is not read.
- `packages/verify/src/parent-write-reach.test.ts`: the fixture's manager position reads the people a contract's required signer names.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/predicate-relationship-traversal.dogfood.test.ts`: the member who cannot read the parent is answered `reference_not_found` on `parent`, and nothing is stored.

<details><summary>Ablations (recorded on #30672 at 75a7c44d96; since then the rule's seven source files changed only by main's unrelated navigation-contribution hunk in engine.ts): each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored blob equal to HEAD, git diff HEAD empty</summary>

The objectql pins import `./engine.js` from source and plugin-security's vitest aliases `@objectstack/objectql` to source, so each mutation is read from `src/`.

1. `delegatedUnitReadScope` returns `{}` instead of `{ id: { $in: [...ids] } }`: delegated-admin posture suite 6 failed | 27 passed — the exact-read pin and the outside-unit `reference_not_found` pin × 3 postures.
2. The middleware's admission set to `null`: 21 failed | 12 passed; the no-scope and organization-admin controls green.
3. `referencesCheckedBeforeRules` returns `false`: 17 failed | 82 passed — every before-the-rules pin on four doors × three field types, the exists-nowhere pins and the preview pin; controls green.
4. The same predicate returns `true`: 4 failed | 95 passed — the flow-run system-write order control × four doors.
5. A failed caller read returns the asked ids: 9 failed | 90 passed — the fails-closed pin and the refused-read pins.
6. An unresolvable target returns `false`: 1 failed | 98 passed — the unregistered-object pin.
7. After the #30546 merge, the user reference's caller read door removed (the ban probe alone): 17 failed | 93 passed over `engine-banned-user-reference` and `engine-unreadable-reference-target` — the two ban pins on the caller's read and 15 `lookup` / `user` pins.

</details>

## Deviations

- #30546 (#30205) landed on `main` during this card and changed the same reference check. Its test rig gave a non-system caller no read of `sys_user` at all, and one of its pins held that such a caller is still answered `reference_user_banned`; ruling 6663849489 answers that caller `reference_not_found`. The rig now gives its caller the read of a user's id a member has, that pin now holds that the ban is read elevated, and a new pin holds the ruling's answer. Ablation 7 above: 17 red.
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` and `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/__tests__/rig-users.testkit.ts` sit outside the named file surface: the system-context census needs a row naming `referencesCheckedBeforeRules`, and the tenant-audit census would otherwise count the testkit's system insert as an application write.
- Test Core 4/8 on #30672 (seat record 6671674952): `@objectstack/verify`'s parent-write-reach create probe filled a required `lookup` with a record its writer could not read, which the rule now refuses. The verifier's personas now read the probe's off-chain required reference objects (product code, so the changeset adds `'@objectstack/verify': patch`), and the fixture's manager position reads the people a contract's signer names. No rule was loosened.
- Test Core 8/8 on #30672 (6671674952): an agent-ceiling grant suite that landed on `main` writes grants whose holders had no directory record, so the rule refused the holder reference. The suite now provisions its three users the way the sibling grant suites do. No rule was loosened.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/runas-system-reference-check.integration.test.ts` still names `masterDetailHeaderExists` in a comment, outside this card's surface.
- The delegate read covers a caller's own read; a read on another's behalf (`delegatorSets`) is not widened. Explain and `canReadObject` do not reflect the delegate read.

## Verification

All on head `0e54448624`: #30672's released head `4ba91079fb` with `origin/main` `06cccd32e1` merged (no conflict; no file of this diff was touched by the nine incoming commits), after a whole-workspace build of the merged tree (`turbo run build`, 118 of 118 tasks). The delta against `main` is unchanged by the merge: 39 files, +1317 / −246.

- `@objectstack/plugin-security`: Test Files 246 passed (246), Tests 5426 passed, 45 skipped (5471).
- `@objectstack/plugin-audit`: Test Files 73 passed (73), Tests 1145 passed (1145).
- `@objectstack/verify`: Test Files 48 passed (48), Tests 408 passed (408).
- The merge brought in a change to a banned user's work hand-over (`@objectstack/core`), which writes `owner_id` as the caller: `core` `src/security/user-assigned-work.test.ts` 12 passed, `rest` `src/user-work-routes.test.ts` 7 passed.
- `pnpm --filter PACKAGE typecheck` for objectql, plugin-security, plugin-audit and verify (each with its test program): exit 0.

</details>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` over the 39 changed paths: 97 families, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, all exit 0. `--ran`: 97 derived, 97 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `pnpm check:type-check-debt` first exited 3 because its closure build queued behind the dogfood battery on the shared verify lock and timed out; re-run under the lock after the battery, exit 0.
